mapper.sql: O.ORD_NO, O.MBR_ID, O.ORD_STAT, AS ORD_STAT_NM, O.ORD_AMT, O.CPN_DC_AMT, O.PNT_USE_AMT, O.DLV_FEE, O.PAY_AMT, O.CNCL_AMT, TO_CHAR(O.ORD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ORD_DT, TO_CHAR(O.PAY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PAY_DT, TO_CHAR(O.CNFM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CNFM_DT, TO_CHAR(O.CNCL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CNCL_DT, O.CNFM_TYPE, O.RCV_NM, O.RCV_HP, O.RCV_ZIP, O.RCV_ADDR, O.RCV_ADDR_DTL, O.DLV_MSG, O.ORD_CHNL, O.CNCL_RSN

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_MBR M WHERE M.MBR_ID = O.MBR_ID AND M.MBR_NM LIKE #{MBR_NM} || '%')

if.test: (PRD_CD != null and PRD_CD != '') or (PRD_NM != null and PRD_NM != '') or (SELLER_ID != null and SELLER_ID != '')

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PAY Y WHERE Y.ORD_NO = O.ORD_NO AND Y.PAY_MTHD = #{PAY_MTHD})

mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT M.MBR_NM FROM TB_MBR M WHERE M.MBR_ID = O.MBR_ID) AS MBR_NM FROM TB_ORD O WHERE O.ORD_NO = #{ordNo}
SELECT O.ORD_NO, O.MBR_ID, O.ORD_STAT, O.ORD_AMT, O.CPN_DC_AMT, O.PNT_USE_AMT, O.DLV_FEE, O.PAY_AMT, O.CNCL_AMT FROM TB_ORD O WHERE O.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT I.ORD_NO, I.ITEM_SEQ, I.PRD_CD, P.PRD_NM, I.SELLER_ID, (SELECT S.SELLER_NM FROM TB_SELLER S WHERE S.SELLER_ID = I.SELLER_ID) AS SELLER_NM, I.QTY, I.UNIT_PRC, I.ITEM_AMT, I.ITEM_STAT, DECODE(I.ITEM_STAT, 'N', '정상', 'C', '취소', 'R', '반품요청', 'X', '반품완료', I.ITEM_STAT) AS ITEM_STAT_NM, I.CPN_DC_SHARE_AMT, I.PNT_SHARE_AMT, I.REFUND_AMT, TO_CHAR(I.CNCL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CNCL_DT, 'N' AS CHK FROM TB_ORD_ITEM I LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PRD P ON P.PRD_CD = I.PRD_CD WHERE I.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} ORDER BY I.ITEM_SEQ

SELECT H.ORD_NO, H.HIST_SEQ, H.BF_STAT, H.AF_STAT, DECODE(H.AF_STAT, '10', '주문접수', '20', '결제완료', '30', '상품준비', '40', '출고', '50', '배송완료', '60', '구매확정', '80', '부분취소', '90', '주문취소') AS AF_STAT_NM, H.CHG_RSN, TO_CHAR(H.CHG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHG_DT, H.CHG_ID FROM TB_ORD_STAT_HIST H WHERE H.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} ORDER BY H.HIST_SEQ

SELECT O.ORD_NO, O.MBR_ID, TO_CHAR(O.UPD_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS UPD_YMD FROM TB_ORD O WHERE O.ORD_STAT = '50' AND O.UPD_DT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{CNFM_DAYS} + 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ORD_ITEM I WHERE I.ORD_NO = O.ORD_NO AND I.ITEM_STAT = 'R') ORDER BY O.ORD_NO
